properties.name: Tyrone local mine drawing grid (feet; custom/local; not EPSG; NOT WGS84)

metadata.coordinate_reference_note: Coordinates are in the CQAR drawing local mine grid, not longitude/latitude. Do not overlay directly on satellite rasters until a verified local-grid-to-run-raster transform is recovered.
metadata.geometry_provenance: Digitized from visible plot boundary centerlines on official coordinate-controlled AS-BUILT drawing; not original CAD/survey vertices.
metadata.official_acreage_note: Official printed acreage is retained independently from digitized planimetric polygon area; geometry was not altered to force an acreage match.

properties.geometry_provenance: Boundary centerline digitized from official coordinate-controlled CQAR AS-BUILT drawing; coordinates reconstructed from labeled local mine grid; raster stair-stepping simplified below one source-render pixel; not original CAD/survey vertices.
properties.geometry_coordinate_system: Tyrone local mine drawing grid; feet; westing represented as signed negative W values and northing positive N values; no EPSG assignment verified.
